holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: For the quarter ended September 2026, standalone profit reached ₹14,843 crore and consolidated net profit was ₹16,333 crore.
Quarterly net profit rose to ₹17,389 crore with revenue increasing to ₹55,992 crore.
The bank's CASA ratio dropped by 340 bps to 36.1% amid a surge in FCNR (B) deposits.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 6.90% of the portfolio, ICICI Bank is the fund's largest single position. Although 3-month return fell 3.87%, 1-month return rebounded 2.97%, providing anchor stability within the 32.2% Financials exposure.

watch.text: Watch the impact of deposit mix shifts and FCNR (B) growth on margins following the CASA ratio decline to 36.1%.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank reported September 2026 quarter revenue of ₹95,132 crore and net profit of ₹21,537 crore.
Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026.
An internal probe found that two senior executives leaked confidential business information.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank is the fund's second-largest holding at 6.24% and the largest 3-month performance drag, contributing -0.383% as the stock declined 6.13% over 3 months and 29.85% over 1 year.

watch.text: Monitor leadership succession following the departure of Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha on December 31, 2026.
Track corporate governance developments related to internal investigations over executive leaks.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T bagged large orders for Secretariat buildings in New Delhi and two office towers in Amaravati.
The company received a limited notice to proceed for the New Tashkent airport and began pre-construction activities.
The Indian Navy commissioned warship Samarthak, built by Larsen & Toubro.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.32% fund weight, L&T anchors the fund's 12.1% Industrials allocation. The stock dropped 4.75% over 3 months and 6.88% over 1 month ahead of its Q2 results.

watch.text: Watch the Q2 and half-year FY2026 financial results scheduled for consideration on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: USFDA granted final approval for Perampanel Tablets, with a commercial launch planned in Q3 FY27.
Aurobindo completed the acquisition of A1 Labs LLC on October 2, 2026, for USD 15.247 million, acquiring an 80% stake in A1 Labs India and its U.S. subsidiary.
The company recalled over 1.1 lakh bottles of paracetamol in the United States.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.03% of the portfolio, Aurobindo delivered a +2.95% return over 3 months (+0.089% estimated fund contribution) and gained 43.46% over the past year, supporting the fund's 11.2% Healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Track the commercial rollout of Perampanel Tablets scheduled for Q3 FY27.

holdings.name: JSW Infrastructure Ltd

what_changed.text: Listed subsidiary Navkar Corporation received an LOA for a ₹48 crore Gati Shakti cargo terminal contract.
CARE reaffirmed JSW Infrastructure's issuer rating at AA+ Stable and enhanced bank facilities to ₹660 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: JSW Infrastructure accounts for 2.81% of fund assets within the 12.1% Industrials sector. It slid 7.89% over the past month and 2.42% over 3 months, despite a 15.91% gain over 6 months.

watch.text: Review Q2 and H1 FY26 financial results scheduled for board approval on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Bajaj Auto Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 sales increased 5% to 5,38,443 units, while cumulative April-September 2026 sales climbed 24% to 29,87,135 units.
The company launched the Pulsar N250SS in India at Rs 1.59 lakh.

expected.text: Q2 earnings preview estimates project profit to rise 27% and revenue to reach near ₹19,000 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.65% weight in the portfolio, Bajaj Auto retreated 12.11% in the past month and 8.42% in 3 months, weighing on the 13.8% Consumer Discretionary bucket.

watch.text: Assess Q2 and half-year FY27 financial results and conference call on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: For the September 2026 quarter, net profit rose to ₹6,367 crore while Gross NPA increased to 1.06% from 0.96% in the prior quarter.
The company flagged early signs of asset quality stress in gold loans.
Bajaj Finance allotted ₹2,120 crore worth of secured NCDs maturing in October 2031.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.50% portfolio weight, Bajaj Finance was the third-largest negative contributor over 3 months (-0.317%), falling 12.67% over 3 months and 9.33% over the past month.

watch.text: Monitor asset quality trends following the sequential uptick in Gross NPA to 1.06% and stress flagged in gold loans.

holdings.name: Eicher Motors Ltd

what_changed.text: Royal Enfield posted September 2026 sales of 1,33,958 motorcycles, an increase of 8%, and introduced the Himalayan 440.
VECV commercial vehicle sales surged 49.6% year-on-year in September 2026 to 11,396 units.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.46% weight, Eicher Motors' 6.05% drop over 3 months contributed to performance pressure in the 13.8% Consumer Discretionary sector despite steady monthly volume expansion.

watch.text: Track volume traction of the newly introduced Himalayan 440 and commercial vehicle deliveries via VECV.

holdings.name: Titan Company Ltd

what_changed.text: In its Q2 FY27 update, consumer businesses registered 25% year-on-year growth with 78 net store additions.
The company redeemed ₹1,825 crore of commercial papers across two tranches in October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Titan represents 2.41% of fund assets. Despite strong Q2 operational growth, the stock slid 10.14% over 1 month and 7.02% over 3 months, trading at a P/E multiple of 68.13.

watch.text: Evaluate audited profitability metrics during the Q2 FY27 earnings release on November 5, 2026.

holdings.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India

what_changed.text: LIC scheduled a board meeting for November 5, 2026, to approve Q2 and H1 FY27 results.
The insurer announced the launch of three new domestic insurance products effective October 19, 2026.
Five independent directors were appointed for four-year terms from October 7, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.20% of the portfolio, LIC fell 7.38% over 3 months and 12.11% over 1 year, adding to the downward drag from the 32.2% Financials sector.

watch.text: Review half-year earnings and margins at the upcoming board meeting on November 5, 2026.
Track adoption and premium collection from the three new products launched in mid-October 2026.

portfolio.statement: SBI Flexicap Fund is heavily tilted toward Financials (32.2%), Consumer Discretionary (13.8%), and Industrials (12.1%), where recent drawdowns in heavyweights have weighed on short-term fund performance.
interp: The fund's 3-month return of -3.94% and 1-year return of -6.80% reflect steep drags from core private financials like HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance, alongside broad corrections in auto and consumer discretionary holdings.
Pockets of resilience have come from mid-cap technology, exporters, and selective healthcare names, such as Coforge (+32.59% 3M return) and Aurobindo Pharma (+2.95% 3M return).
portfolio.line: A financial and cyclical consumption core weighed down by multi-quarter corrections in large-cap lenders.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank contributed -0.383% over 3 months as its stock declined 6.13%, pressured by leadership departures and confidential information leaks.
Bajaj Finance deducted -0.317% over 3 months amid rising Gross NPAs to 1.06% and stress in gold financing.
Aurobindo Pharma provided a positive 3-month contribution (+0.089%) driven by steady earnings growth and USFDA approvals.

themes.title: Private Banking & Credit Disruption
themes.text: Large financial holdings face margin compressions from deposit rebalancing and selective asset quality pressure, while navigating corporate investigations and executive transitions.

themes.title: Automotive & Retail Consumption Demand
themes.text: Two-wheeler and retail consumer leaders posted expanding monthly volumes and retail store additions, yet experienced sharp 1-month share price corrections.

themes.title: Domestic Capital Expenditure and Infrastructure
themes.text: Large contractors and port operators continue to secure domestic infrastructure contracts and aviation works despite short-term stock pullbacks.

macro.why: A contraction in CASA ratios and reliance on high-cost or foreign deposits impacts core financing profitability across primary banking holdings.
Early stress signals in unsecured or gold financing portfolios directly impact credit costs and valuation multiples in retail lenders.

priced_in.text: Robust quarterly volume expansion and 25% YoY business growth across vehicle and jewelry retail segments.
Sustained order book accumulation in commercial construction and airport infrastructure.

could_change.title: Asset Quality Deterioration in Consumer Lending
could_change.text: Further acceleration of NPAs in consumer and gold finance could trigger additional de-rating across financial holdings.

could_change.title: Regulatory Clearance and Generic Rollouts in Healthcare
could_change.text: Successful execution of US commercial launches like Perampanel could further bolster mid-cap healthcare returns.

portfolio.risk_note: Financials represent 32.2% of the fund, leaving overall returns vulnerable to further credit cost rises or margin squeezes in HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Bajaj Finance.
